faces.name: Rebuff the Wicked

do.reason: No predicate describes a spell by what it targets. TargetedBy runs the other way — it admits an object that is targeted by the given object — so the restriction "that targets a permanent you control" cannot be put on the target filter, and countering an unrestricted target spell would be a different card.
do.text: Counter target spell that targets a permanent you control.
